I was gifted the PanOxyl 2% Salicylic Acid Clarifying Exfoliant complimentary from PanOxyl and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using AHA exfoliants for a while (mainly glycolic acid) and have never noticed much of a difference in my skin. Since incorporating PanOxyl's Salicylic Acid, a BHA, I finally saw the change in my skin that I was hoping for. BHA's penetrate more deeply than AHA's, and unclog pores while decreasing oil production. My skin texture, typically dull and bumpy, has become glowing and smooth. I did go through a bit of a purging stage, which is to be expected, but this was gentle on my skin and did not cause any burning, redness, or irritation. My skin barrier has remained intact! It is fragrance free (another plus… scented products can be irritating to my sensitive skin) and cost effective. I absolutely recommend this product. It has taken my skin from dull and flat to bright and supple.

avis.texte: I had no idea that when you have oily skin, the buildup of oils and dead skin cells could actually hurt your skin even more and make it more dull & lackluster. I have always been intrigued by exfoliants and clarifying products, but I tend to shy away from them knowing if I strip all of the oils out of my skin it can actually make me more oily. This products does a great job at removing dead skin cells, and stripping SOME oil out of the skin without leaving the skin dry to become more oily. It's the perfect balance!

PanOxyl Clarifying Exfoliant 2% Salicylic Acid might be what your skincare routine is missing. The dropper top makes it easy to dispense just the right amount needed to apply to my face. It has no fragrance and absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness or residue behind. Your mmv but I didn't have any excessive flaking or dryness. I use this every other night and saw results in just a few uses. This totally cleared up the congestion on my cheeks. PanOyxl is a trustworthy brand and I highly recommend this product to complete my skincare regimen. I am thankful to have been gifted this item and this review isn't biased by that.
It works great. My skin looks clear and smooth! The texture is great, my face feels very clean and soft after cleansing!

I loved this PanOxyl Clarifying Exfoliant with 2% Salicylic Acid. The packaging was attractive. The bottle easily dispensed the needed amount of product. It made my skin feel soft to the touch. It definitely helped reduce breakouts. I would recommend this product to others.

Portability size and effectiveness is what I found in the sampling and review of PanOxyl . The size is large enough for several uses and just right to fit in travel gear if necessary. It was effective in brightening my skin via the exfoliating. It controlled the oiliness and I had no acne breakout . Will purchase for future use .

avis.titre: Nice product, not for my skin
avis.texte: I've used panoxyl face wash for a long time so I was excited to try this. It is easy to apply and goes on nicely. However, even with extra moisturizer, it severely dried out my skin. I've used salicylic acid before without irritation; my skin just does not love this particular one. I'm ecstatic panoxyl is expanding their brand though - their adapelene is excellent!
I love it, it made my face very smooth and clear over a week period of time.
Great exfoliant for oily skin . If you have a combination skin , it may be too much . It does its work to the max .

I have been using PanOxyl Clarifying Exfoliant 2% Salicylic Acid for my acne prone skin. I had a breakout and use this twice a day to minimize my acne and clear my skin. I have really liked using this product in my daily routine.

avis.titre: Trusted brand and easy to use.
avis.texte: I liked how easy it was to use the product. I felt my skin was fresh and clean. The product was also gentle enough and didn't cause any harsh burning or irritation.

avis.titre: This product didn't work for me.
avis.texte: This product hasn't worked for me. It has left my skin so dry that it has become a rash & very sore. I don't know if it's because of my age or type of skin.
It is a good acne cleanser that does what it says it will do. I did not have an acne when using this product. Over all it's good option for teenagers who want to control their acne.

Smells great, doesn't dry out the skin and effectively removes dead skin! It leaves my skin feeling smooth, soft and whitehead free. Also good for oily skin. I recommend to all types of skin due to its gentleness, effectiveness and dual effects.

This product is super easy to use. It doesn't have a scent and it also isn't super strong that it makes my face sting. I like the container it comes in and the fact that it is a liquid product you can just use a cotton ball to apply it with.

I didn't get the desired results I was hoping for. I loved the packaging of this product and loved that there was a heavy fragrance! It applied very easily because the consistency was more of a watery consistency which meant I had to use a little more than I intended since I used cotton pads to apply to my face. Unfortunately after a few days I noticed that I was getting more frequent breakouts and after a week I decided to discontinue use.

This product has really helped with my breakouts. I had several breakouts on my face when I started using this and it only took a few uses to be able to see a difference and it has also helped with preventing more breakouts!! I will definitely be buying this and recommending it all the time!!
